question: What kind of fever is removed by an oblation of cut pieces with milk?
premises: An oblation of cut pieces with milk is performed.
The oblation removes all of that fever.
inference: An oblation of cut pieces with milk removes every cruel fever.
uncertainties: The exact substance of the cut pieces is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: By an oblation of cut pieces with milk, one may remove all cruel fever.
